#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static std::vector<double> cs(1 << 20);
static std::vector<double> sn(1 << 20);
static std::vector<double> csi(1 << 20);
static std::vector<double> sni(1 << 20);
static bool init_done = false;

void initFFT() {
    if (init_done) return;
    init_done = true;
    for (int len = 1; len <= (1 << 20); len <<= 1) {
        for (int i = len / 2; i < len; i++) {
            cs[i] = std::cos(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            sn[i] = std::sin(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            csi[i] = std::cos(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            sni[i] = std::sin(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
        }
    }
}

static int bit_reverse(int x, int bits) {
    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < bits; i++) {
        res = (res << 1) | (x & 1);
        x >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

void fft(std::vector<double>& a, std::vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = (int)a.size();
    int bits = 0;
    while ((1 << bits) < n) bits++;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = bit_reverse(i, bits);
        if (i < j) {
            std::swap(a[i], a[j]);
            std::swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                double wA = inverse ? csi[halfLen + j] : cs[halfLen + j];
                double wB = inverse ? sni[halfLen + j] : sn[halfLen + j];
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

std::vector<int> multiplyMod(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = (int)a.size() + (int)b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;
    if (n < 2) n = 2;

    std::vector<double> aReal(n, 0), aImag(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(aReal, aImag, false);

    std::vector<double> bReal(n, 0), bImag(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bReal, bImag, false);

    std::vector<double> faReal(n), faImag(n), fbReal(n), fbImag(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
        double a1i = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) / 2;
        double a2r = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) / 2;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
        double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) / 2;
        double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) / 2;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal, faImag, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImag, true);

    std::vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImag[i] + 0.5);
        long long val = aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30);
        res[i] = (int)(val % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader(FILE* f) : f(f) {}
    int nextInt() {
        int c = getc(f);
        while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == EOF)
            c = getc(f);
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = getc(f);
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getc(f);
        }
        return res * sign;
    }
private:
    FILE* f;
};

int main() {
    initFFT();
    InputReader in(stdin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    std::vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x = in.nextInt();
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    std::vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    const int mod = 998244353;
    while (true) {
        if (p & 1) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p >>= 1;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
    }
    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % mod;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", res);
    return 0;
}
